items.name: gd-devel
items.summary: The development libraries and header files for gd
items.description:
The gd-devel package contains the development libraries and header
files for gd, a graphics library for creating PNG and JPEG graphics.

items.name: google-noto-sans-nko-fonts
items.description:
Noto fonts aims to remove tofu from web by providing fonts for all
Unicode supported scripts. Its design goal is to achieve visual harmonization
between multiple scripts. Noto family supports almost all scripts available
in Unicode.
Noto Sans NKo font.

items.name: sssd-polkit-rules
items.summary: Rules for polkit integration for SSSD
items.description:
Provides rules for polkit integration with SSSD. This is required
for smartcard support.

items.name: crash-gcore-command
items.summary: Gcore extension module for the crash utility
items.description:
Command for creating a core dump file of a user-space task that was
running in a kernel dump file.

items.name: geocode-glib-devel
items.description:
The geocode-glib-devel package contains libraries and header files for
developing applications that use geocode-glib.

items.name: python3-ldb
items.summary: Python bindings for the LDB library
items.description: Python bindings for the LDB library

items.name: virtio-win
items.description:
VirtIO para-virtualized Windows(R) drivers for 32-bit and 64-bit
Windows(R) guests.

items.name: systemd-oomd
items.description:
systemd-oomd is a system service that uses cgroups-v2 and pressure stall
information (PSI) to monitor and take action on processes before an OOM
occurs in kernel space.

items.name: elfutils-debuginfod-client
items.summary: Library and command line client for build-id HTTP ELF/DWARF server
items.description:
The elfutils-debuginfod-client package contains shared libraries
dynamically loaded from -ldw, which use a debuginfod service
to look up debuginfo and associated data. Also includes a
command-line frontend.

items.name: tftp-server
items.summary: The server for the Trivial File Transfer Protocol (TFTP)
items.description:
The Trivial File Transfer Protocol (TFTP) is normally used only for
booting diskless workstations.  The tftp-server package provides the
server for TFTP, which allows users to transfer files to and from a
remote machine. TFTP provides very little security, and should not be
enabled unless it is expressly needed.  The TFTP server is run by using
systemd socket activation, and is disabled by default.

items.name: brltty-at-spi2
items.description: This package provides the AtSpi2 driver for BRLTTY.

items.name: perl-DBI
items.summary: A database access API for perl
items.description:
DBI is a database access Application Programming Interface (API) for
the Perl Language. The DBI API Specification defines a set of
functions, variables and conventions that provide a consistent
database interface independent of the actual database being used.

items.name: texlive-xetex-pstricks
items.description:
The package provides an indirection scheme for XeTeX to use the
pstricks xdvipdfmx.cfg configuration file, so that XeTeX
documents will load it in preference to the standard
pstricks.con configuration file. With this configuration, many
PSTricks features can be used in xelatex or plain xetex
documents.

items.name: libblockdev-loop
items.summary: The loop plugin for the libblockdev library
items.description:
The libblockdev library plugin (and in the same time a standalone library)
providing the functionality related to loop devices.

items.name: mtdev
items.description:
mtdev is a stand-alone library which transforms all variants of kernel MT
events to the slotted type B protocol. The events put into mtdev may be from
any MT device, specifically type A without contact tracking, type A with
contact tracking, or type B with contact tracking.

items.name: libblockdev-mpath
items.summary: The multipath plugin for the libblockdev library
items.description:
The libblockdev library plugin (and in the same time a standalone library)
providing the functionality related to multipath devices.

items.name: gd
items.summary: A graphics library for quick creation of PNG or JPEG images
items.description:
The gd graphics library allows your code to quickly draw images
complete with lines, arcs, text, multiple colors, cut and paste from
other images, and flood fills, and to write out the result as a PNG or
JPEG file. This is particularly useful in Web applications, where PNG
and JPEG are two of the formats accepted for inline images by most
browsers. Note that gd is not a paint program.

items.name: perl-Exporter
items.summary: Implements default import method for modules
items.description:
The Exporter module implements an import method which allows a module to
export functions and variables to its users' name spaces. Many modules use
Exporter rather than implementing their own import method because Exporter
provides a highly flexible interface, with an implementation optimized for
the common case.

items.name: delve
items.summary: A debugger for the Go programming language
items.description:
Delve is a debugger for the Go programming language. The goal of the project
is to provide a simple, full featured debugging tool for Go. Delve should be
easy to invoke and easy to use. Chances are if you're using a debugger, things
aren't going your way. With that in mind, Delve should stay out of your way as
much as possible.

items.name: p11-kit-trust
items.description:
The p11-kit-trust package contains a system trust PKCS#11 module which
contains certificate anchors and blocklists.

items.name: nbdkit-python-plugin
